checks.committed_closure: All ten implementation, test, documentation, local dependency and package-initializer paths match source_commit Git blobs. Earlier parser, tracker and perception assembly sources/receipts remain unchanged.
checks.features: Exactly 42 float64 features from the own finite float32 descriptor: embedding[7:39], log width/height fractions[2:4], normalized own RGB histogram[41:49]. Position, area, displacement, controllability and solidity do not enter the Euclidean distance.
checks.causal_assignment: Observed instances only, geometry-sorted by minimum distinct source pixel; current-frame earlier categories are immediately available. Nearest category at distance<=threshold is reused; exact ties choose the earliest index. The mean has equal weight per accepted observation, not per track or per pixel.
checks.atomicity: Validation precedes a private category copy. Capacity, count overflow and allocation errors cannot commit category/clock changes. A successful retry contributes once. No silent merges, evictions or excess-category truncation.
checks.bounds: Category capacity1..64; observed-frame capacity1..4096, default512; strictly increasing Python-integer frame0..2**53; category count guard2**53. Feature bounds and float64 log/norm/update prevent overflow on the declared feature domain.
checks.ownership: New centers own independent copies; exported lists are detached and JSON-compatible. Coasting contributes no update. Category and track numbers supply no semantic game labels. No RAM, native state, Atari data, teacher, game type or cross-game prior enters this prototype.

limitations: This receipt is a preliminary synthetic source review, not an experiment freeze, native preflight, learning run, measured throughput result or gate.
The module assumes instances already validated by the upstream tracker. It has no image H/W and cannot independently attest tight boxes, source-pixel bounds or descriptor geometry consistency.

A future assembler must guarantee fresh empty codebooks at every game entry in every arm and exclude these local diagnostic exports from lineage inheritance; carried_across_games=false is a declaration, not external provenance enforcement.

Category centers depend on temporal order and historical parser embeddings. Weight changes can make old centers inconsistent with new features. No semantic truth or retrospective relabeling resolves that drift here.

The proposed threshold0.6 and equal feature scaling are not scientifically calibrated. Segmentation noise, animation, palette changes and scale changes can exhaust capacity; future protocols must record refusals and define their treatment before data collection.
The numerical bounds do not establish total memory or runtime bounds for real workloads. Input pixel validation and deep copies have additional cost.
No behavior-based merging, reusable skill, persistent semantic identity, downstream loss or collector integration is included.
